SECRET
（印：MINISTERIAL POLICE BR. REGISTRY N. 966 Date 15/7/41）

July 11, 1941.

Entry of Russian members of S.M.P. into
Canada and Austrailia for Long Leave

Canada

I beg to report having interviewed Mr. V.E.
Duclos, Canadian Government Trade Commissioner, in
connection with above matter. He stated that it
was at present practically impossible for any alien
to secure entry to Canada for any purpose. He added
that he had no absolute authority in this matter,
this being vested in Mr. E.S. Doughty, Special
Immigration Officer for Canada, P.O. Box 247, Hongkong,
who would review any particular case on its own merits.

Mr. Duclos was then asked the position of
British members of the Force married to aliens and
replied that it was difficult for one of pure British
descent to obtain a visa to enter Canada during
wartime, and naturally marriage to a woman of another
nationality would tend to increase the difficulties.
He suggested that Commissioner of Police write
officially to Mr. Doughty who would be able to furnish
full details. Attached is a questionnaire showing
the particulars an applicant for a visa would be
required to furnish.

Australia

（印：警务处秘书科登记室 第966号 日期：1941年7月15日）

1941年7月11日。

关于上海公共租界工部局警务处俄籍员警赴加拿大及澳大利亚长期休假之入境事宜

加拿大

谨报告，本人就上述事项采访了加拿大政府贸易专员 V.E. Duclos 先生。他表示，目前任何外籍人士实际上均无法以任何目的获准进入加拿大。他补充说，他在此事上并无绝对权力，该权力归属于加拿大特别移民官 E.S. Doughty 先生（通讯地址：香港邮政信箱247号），后者将根据具体情况对个案进行审查。

随后问及本队英籍员警中与外籍人士结婚者的处境，Duclos 先生回答说，在战时，纯英国血统者很难获得进入加拿大的签证，而与另一国籍女子结婚自然会增加困难。他建议警务处处长正式致函 Doughty 先生，后者能够提供详尽细节。随函附有一份问卷，列明了签证申请人需提供的具体信息。

澳大利亚

本人采访了澳大利亚政府贸易专员 V.G. Bowden 先生（C.B.E.勋衔），他表示据其所知并不存在任何限制，但该事项应由

Mr. Cox, H.B.M. Passport Officer.
I accordingly consulted Mr. Cox who informed
me that each application would be judged on its merits
and would need to be sent to Canberra for decision.
The question of Britishers married to aliens
was put to him and he replied that the women were
British by virtue of marriage and no restriction to
their entry existed.
In the course of the interview with Mr. Bowden,
he stated that a certificate of identity attesting the
fact that the bearer was returning to his employment in
the S.M.P. at the expiration of his leave and bearing
the Commissioner's signature would no doubt simplify
matters.
Mr. Cox was asked how European Political
Refugees were affected and replied that entry to
Australia was impossible for them.

英国陛下护照官 Cox 先生处理。
因此，本人咨询了 Cox 先生，他告知每项申请都将根据具体情况予以评判，并需送交堪培拉作出决定。
当问及与外籍人士结婚的英国人问题时，他回答说，这些女性因婚姻关系而具有英国国籍，其入境不受任何限制。
在与 Bowden 先生的会谈中，他表示，一份证明持有人在休假期满后返回上海公共租界工部局警务处复职的身份证明书，并附有警务处处长的签名，无疑将简化相关手续。
当问及欧洲政治难民受此影响的情况时，Cox 先生回答说，他们不可能进入澳大利亚。
